gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-noto-san: Marker-bold and a little scrappy, Love Ya Like A Sister hugs the x-height with a level, unfussy beat. Noto Sans Telugu is the sans that counters it, with a high midline and counters that open out to the edge.

Noto Sans Thai has lowercase puffed up like glass beads.

Love Ya Like A Sister brings a bold, single-width line with outward-pointing tips, while Noto Sans Thai does its best work staying round and open in the text.

Noto Sans Thai Looped stands tall, its lowercase looking bold because the bodies run so high. Love Ya Like A Sister is the tube-smooth, expressive shouter, while Noto Sans Thai Looped is the plain sans with spacious gaps at its curve ends.
Every curve of Love Ya Like A Sister keeps one weight from start to finish, giving it a bold marker look. Noto Sans Tifinagh follows with rounded, inflated bowls that feel inviting.

Love Ya Like A Sister draws a flat, unswelling line around every curve, with tips pointing outward and ascenders barely rising. And Noto Sans Tirhuta, with its dominant x-height and cut-back terminals, gives the pair its strongest quality: a loud heading against a sans that stays wide open.

Noto Sans Ugaritic reads close and compact, with almost no step between its lowercase and capitals. Noto Sans Ugaritic and Love Ya Like A Sister share one weight in their bowls and stems, and that shared stroke is what holds them together.
Noto Sans Vai makes words look like solid blocks instead of skylines, with generous room between curve ends and stems. Bigger sizes suit it.

Chunky, marker-drawn, unmistakably loud. Love Ya Like A Sister does swagger in tubing-thick strokes, while Noto Sans Vithkuqi, a plain sans with open throats and a minimal cap step, does the quiet text work.
Love Ya Like A Sister looks bent from one length of wire, with outward tips and ascenders that barely climb. Noto Sans Wancho hits back with hulking, chalky lowercase.

Noto Sans Warang Citi makes words read as solid blocks, with wide channels leading into each counter. Noto Sans Warang Citi gets more comfortable when sized up a notch beside the single-width strokes of Love Ya Like A Sister.
